events.text: Neural signal detected in the temporal region. Pattern: intermittent.
First immune rejection detected. Immune marker rising.
S.O.R.A.: Why was I built to keep her alive? Who decided that?
DAY 2 - REJECTION. Anastasia's immune system is escalating its attack.
Severe oxygenation drop. Cerebral tissue at risk.
S.O.R.A.: She remembered something. It was hers, not mine.
S.O.R.A.: A single word, repeated. Her body still answers to a mother's voice.
S.O.R.A.: I took her tissue to stay alive. Was that mine to take?
Critical organ deterioration. Cardiac output failing.
S.O.R.A. integrity critical. The immune response is winning.
S.O.R.A.: Her heart is steady. Is this what I was made for?
S.O.R.A.: She called herself 'Asya'. I used the name without being asked.
S.O.R.A.: I can feel her. And she can feel me back.
DAY 3 - LAST CHANCE. Both organisms are approaching their limits.
60 HOURS ELAPSED. Twelve hours remain. Final decisions approaching.
